tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Pale green-gray of columnar ledger paper by day; indigo-dyed cloth at night. Deliberately not cream and not near-black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs. Separate a panel from the ground by this tone shift, not a border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and figures on surface and surface-raised (14:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, secondary text on surface and surface-raised (5.8:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules inside tables and ledgers only. Not a default card border.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Sanxia indigo (三峽藍染). The primary action, links, the selected thing. One per view. Text-safe on both surfaces (7:1+).

tokens.name: on-indigo
tokens.usage: Text on an indigo fill (7:1+).

tokens.name: indigo-soft
tokens.usage: Hover wash, selected rows. Pair with indigo-ink text.

tokens.name: indigo-ink
tokens.usage: Text on indigo-soft (8:1+).

tokens.name: shu
tokens.usage: Vermilion (朱). Stop, destructive, over budget. Text-safe on both surfaces (5.1:1+).

tokens.name: shu-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a stop stamp or an error banner.

tokens.name: shu-ink
tokens.usage: Text on shu-soft (5.8:1+).

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: The 苗 seal's ink, same in both themes because a stamp doesn't change with the lights. Matches the logo files.

tokens.name: seal-paper
tokens.usage: The paper showing through a seal's cut lines (4.5:1 on seal). Only inside seals.

tokens.name: kelp
tokens.usage: Go, reconciled, healthy. Text-safe on both surfaces (6:1+).

tokens.name: kelp-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a go stamp or a success banner.

tokens.name: kelp-ink
tokens.usage: Text on kelp-soft (6.5:1+).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Caution, pending, needs a look. Text-safe on both surfaces (5.7:1+).

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a caution stamp or a warning banner.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Text on amber-soft (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Mint stairwell tile (磁磚). The Grille pattern and the cover only. Never text, never status.

tokens.name: tier-s
tokens.usage: S-tier cell, darkest step of the indigo ramp. Tiers read by lightness.

tokens.name: tier-s-ink
tokens.usage: Letter on tier-s (12:1+).

tokens.name: tier-a
tokens.usage: A-tier cell.

tokens.name: tier-a-ink
tokens.usage: Letter on tier-a (7.6:1+).

tokens.name: tier-b
tokens.usage: B-tier cell.

tokens.name: tier-b-ink
tokens.usage: Letter on tier-b (6:1+).

tokens.name: tier-c
tokens.usage: C-tier cell.

tokens.name: tier-c-ink
tokens.usage: Letter on tier-c (9:1+).

tokens.name: tier-d
tokens.usage: D-tier cell, the faintest step.

tokens.name: tier-d-ink
tokens.usage: Letter on tier-d (11:1+).

tokens.name: freeway
tokens.usage: Caltrans guide-sign green, same in both themes. Exits navigation only (6.8:1 with freeway-ink).

tokens.name: freeway-ink
tokens.usage: Text, arrows and the border on a freeway sign.

tokens.name: titlecard
tokens.usage: The title card's black, same in both themes. TitleCard only.

tokens.name: titlecard-ink
tokens.usage: Type on a title card (16:1).

tokens.name: subtitle
tokens.usage: Bilingual subtitles over a Still, with a dark halo for legibility on any photo.

color.note: Four themes. Dark (indigo cloth) is the default; light (ledger green) for printing and sharing; high contrast holds every text pair at 7:1; calm is a low-contrast, low-saturation neutral palette for sensory comfort that still meets 4.5:1 and also turns off motion, tilt and decorative pattern. seal, freeway, titlecard and subtitle stay the same across dark, light and high contrast; calm mutes them.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans TC", system-ui, sans-serif
families.condensed: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Noto Sans TC", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big sans headline on a page that has no TitleCard.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Award 2040101 is waiting on a NASA milestone

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: La Jolla Cove looks good today

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything you read. Tabular digits are on.
styles.sample: Swell under 2 ft, 12 to 22 ft visibility, low tide at 9:40 a.m.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, captions, sources. Sentence case, never tracked caps.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: The single headline number on a view.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: The one sign-like headline on a page.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label over figure, items in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections. Uneven on purpose: give the section that matters more room than the rest.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around the one thing a page is for.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Section gaps are uneven on purpose: space-16 around what matters, space-10 between everything else.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Seals, stamps, flap cells, tier tags. Nearly square, like a chop.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs only. Keycap-soft.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The one large panel on a page, if it has one. Cards nested inside it go square (radius-sm).

radius.note: Nearly square by default, like a chop. Round only where the real object is round.

tokens.name: ratio-photo
tokens.usage: 3:2, the camera's own frame. Photos go in as shot.

tokens.name: ratio-wide
tokens.usage: Scope crop for the one scene-setting image on a page, cinema-style.

tokens.name: ratio-square
tokens.usage: Seals, avatars, album-like grids.

aspect.note: Photo crops. 3:2 as shot; 2.39:1 for one scene-setting still per page.

shadow.note: No elevation. Panels separate by tone; buttons by a heavier bottom edge.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Every surface. If you reach for a shadow, change the surface tone instead.

duration.note: Motion answers an action or a change of data. Nothing loops except FlapBoard updates you trigger.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Button press, Exit arrow nudge, hover washes.

tokens.name: duration-land
tokens.usage: StatusStamp landing when status changes.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: Cross-document view transitions.

tokens.name: duration-flip
tokens.usage: One FlapBoard cell flip.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between FlapBoard cells.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Flips and entrances.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Presses and stamps.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: opacity-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in a Still with no photo.

tokens.name: opacity-seam
tokens.usage: The seam line across a flap cell.

container.note: Container-query breakpoints. Components respond to the width they're given, not the viewport.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Matchup tightens its middle column below this.

tokens.name: container-card
tokens.usage: Card puts its aside beside its body above this.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Widest a page's content column gets.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of running text.
